SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.intro, COALESCE(SUM(sv.views), 0) * 2 AS heat, u.create_time FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN store_visit sv ON sv.user_id = u.id AND sv.status = 1 WHERE u.role = 0 AND u.is_expert = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.intro, u.create_time ORDER BY heat DESC, u.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id} AND role = 0 AND is_expert = 1
